Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.layout

Class LayoutInput

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.layout.LayoutInput
public final class LayoutInput extends Object
What the drawing side tells the layout: Smetana does not measure text, so the size of every node and label is computed beforehand by PlantUML. All sizes are in pixels (which Graphviz calls points).
